items.exampleEn: He is moody in the morning until he has his coffee.
items.exampleZh: 他早上喝咖啡之前，心情總是陰晴不定。

items.exampleEn: The children's book is about a little mouse's bravery.
items.exampleZh: 那本童書講的是一隻小老鼠的勇敢。

items.exampleEn: His habit of being late is really irritating.
items.exampleZh: 他老是遲到的習慣真的很讓人惱火。

items.exampleEn: It was heartbreaking to see the old theater close.
items.exampleZh: 看到那間老劇院關門，真令人心碎。
items.glossZh: 令人心碎的；令人非常難過的

items.exampleEn: The news of her sudden marriage astonished her friends.
items.exampleZh: 她突然結婚的消息讓朋友們大吃一驚。

items.exampleEn: She was appreciative of all the help her neighbors gave her.
items.exampleZh: 她很感激鄰居們給她的所有幫助。

items.exampleEn: The naughty puppy chewed my new shoes.
items.exampleZh: 那隻頑皮的小狗把我的新鞋咬壞了。

items.exampleEn: He laughed uncomfortably when they asked about his grades.
items.exampleZh: 他們問起他的成績時，他尷尬地笑了笑。

items.sentenceEn: It was uncomfortably hot inside the crowded bus.
items.sentenceZh: 擁擠的公車裡熱得讓人難受。

items.audioEn: My cat ignored me all morning, but in the evening she sat on my lap for an hour.
items.audioZh: 我的貓整個早上都不理我，但到了晚上她卻在我腿上坐了一個小時。
options: Sat on the bed for the whole hour

items.sentenceEn: Leaving my best friend at the airport was heartbreaking.
items.sentenceZh: 和最好的朋友在機場分開，真令人心碎。

items.sentenceEn: The magic trick astonished everyone at the party.
items.sentenceZh: 那個魔術讓派對上的每個人都大吃一驚。

items.stemEn: The ____ boy hid his sister's toys and laughed when she couldn't find them.
items.stemZh: 那個淘氣的男孩把妹妹的玩具藏起來，看她找不到就哈哈大笑。

items.stemEn: The firefighter was given a medal for her ____.
items.stemZh: 那位消防員因為勇敢而獲頒獎章。

items.passageEn: This year, our class put on a play about a naughty boy who gets lost in a big city. The story is funny at first, but the ending is heartbreaking when he can't find his way home. My friend Amy played the boy, even though her costume was too big, and her acting astonished everyone. In one scene, the stage lights were uncomfortably bright, and an irritating noise came from the speakers, but she kept going. At the end, the appreciative audience stood up and clapped for a long time.
items.passageZh: 今年我們班演了一齣戲，講一個頑皮男孩在大城市裡迷路的故事。故事一開始很好笑，但結局他找不到回家的路，令人心碎。我朋友 Amy 演那個男孩，雖然戲服太大，她的演技還是讓大家都很驚豔。有一幕舞台燈光亮得讓人難受，喇叭還傳出惱人的雜音，但她繼續演下去。最後，滿懷感謝的觀眾起立鼓掌了很久。

options: 男孩一直找不到回家的路

questions.questionZh: 演出時發生了什麼狀況？

items.promptZh: 我哥哥很情緒化，你永遠不知道他下一刻會有什麼感受。
referenceEn: My brother is moody; you never know how he will feel next.
My older brother is so moody that you never know how he will feel next.
rubricZh: 要用 moody（例如 is moody、so moody that…）
「你永遠不知道」可寫，例如 you never know 等
後半句的連接方式，例如分號、so … that 等都可以

items.promptZh: 大家都稱讚那個男孩的勇敢，因為他把一隻小狗從河裡救了起來。
referenceEn: Everyone praised the boy's bravery because he saved a puppy from the river.
Everyone praised the boy for his bravery after he saved a little dog from the river.
rubricZh: bravery 當名詞（例如 the boy's bravery、praised him for his bravery 等）
「稱讚」可寫，例如 praised、admired 等；「救起」可寫，例如 saved、pulled … out of 等
時態配合句意（例如 praised、praise、saved 等）
